Original citation
Document: TCP/IP Internetworking With gawk
Edition: gawk 5.1.0 / Debian gawk-doc 5.1.0-1
Distribution: https://archive.debian.org/debian/pool/non-free/g/gawk-doc/gawk-doc_5.1.0-1_all.deb
Member: ./usr/share/doc/gawk-doc/gawkinet-html/Gawk-Special-Files.html
Original href: https://www.gnu.org/software/gawk/manual/html_node/Two_002dway-I_002fO.html#Two_002dway-I_002fO
Link text: Two-way Communications With Another Process
Presealed minimum purpose (collector paraphrase): gawk networking을 읽기 전에 coprocess에 print/printf로 보내고 getline으로 받는 양방향 I/O를 이해한다.

Original context:
The ‘|&’ operator for use in
communicating with a coprocess is described in
Two-way Communications With Another Process in GAWK: Effective AWK Programming.
It shows how to do two-way I/O to a
separate process, sending it data with print or printf and
reading data with getline.  If you haven’t read it already, you should
detour there to do so.
